choose.when: select s.id,cast(s.topic_id as char) as objectId,cms_topic.name as title, date_format(s.completed_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as occurredAt from topic_route_session s join cms_topic on cms_topic.id=s.topic_id where s.member_id=#{memberId} and s.status=1 and s.completed_at >= #{start} and s.completed_at < #{end} and cms_topic.status=1 and cms_topic.user_status=1 and cms_topic.del_flag=0 and cms_topic.is_draft=0 and (cms_topic.club_id is null or cms_topic.club_id=0 or exists ( select 1 from club live_club where live_club.id=cms_topic.club_id and live_club.del_flag=0)) and and and (s.activity_id=0 or s.activity_id is null or exists( select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id=s.activity_id and a.topic_id=s.topic_id and a.status=1 and a.publish_status=1 and a.del_flag=0 and a.cancel_time is null and (a.club_id is null or a.club_id=0 or (exists ( select 1 from club active_club where active_club.id=a.club_id and active_club.del_flag=0) and (a.member_id=#{memberId} or exists (select 1 from club_member active_member where active_member.club_id=a.club_id and active_member.member_id=#{memberId} and active_member.status=1 and active_member.del_flag=0))))))

select f.id,cast(f.poi_id as char) as objectId,p.name as title, date_format(f.found_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as occurredAt from roam_poi_found f join roam_session s on s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id and s.status=1 join roam_poi p on p.id=f.poi_id where f.member_id=#{memberId} and f.found_at >= #{start} and f.found_at < #{end} and p.status=1 and (p.application_type is null or p.application_type=2 or (p.application_type=1 and p.audit_status=1))
choose.otherwise: select s.id,cast(s.id as char) as objectId,'城市签' as title, date_format(s.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as occurredAt from roam_stamp s where s.member_id=#{memberId} and s.del_flag=0 and s.check_state!=2 and s.create_time >= #{start} and s.create_time < #{end}
